description.value: Pseudonym of US author Samuel Langhorne Clemens (1835-1910), whose early life and work revolved around the Mississippi River, initially as a steamboat pilot 1857-1861, a job he loved and whose loss because of the outbreak of the Civil War was deeply wounding to him, though he had in fact begun publishing very early, his first piece being "A Gallant Fireman" (16 January 1851 Western Union), and his first piece as Mark Twain a short travel account, in a Nevada newspaper, "Letter from Carson ..." (3 February 1863 Territorial Enterprise).
